title: 인사말 소리대로: 감사합니다, 반갑습니다
objective: You can read -ㅂ니다 and -습니다 words with the real sounds, such as [감사함니다] and [반갑씀니다].
summary: Learn why 감사합니다 and 반갑습니다 sound different from their spelling.

task.title: Read and write sounds
task.line: Use the rules on page 1 to find the real sound, or the spelling, for each word or sentence.

words.exampleMeaning: I'm Minsu. Nice to meet you.

letters.as: Before ㄴ, final ㅂ turns to m, like 'hum-nee-da'.
After ㅂ, ㅅ sounds tense and sharp, like 'ss' in 'kiss'.

exercises: Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 입니다 ② 합니까 ③ 십니다
Choose the correct sound: ① 입습니다 ([입씀니다] / [입슴니다]) ② 잡니다 ([잡니다] / [잠니다]) ③ 덥습니다 ([덤씀니다] / [덥씀니다])
Write how the whole sentence sounds: ① 저는 가수입니다. ② 오늘 만납니다. ③ 우유를 삽니다.
Write the spelling for each sound: ① [춥씀니다] ② [줌니다] ③ [임니까]
answers: ① [저는 가수임니다] ② [오늘 만남니다] ③ [우유를 삼니다]
① 춥습니다 ② 줍니다 ③ 입니까
